The general objective of this call for tender is to ensure the representation of specific stakeholder groups in the EU Ecolabel implementation, in particular during the criteria development process and in enhancing the EU Ecolabel presence on the market by boosting uptake and awareness. 

Specifically:

Lot 1 - Stakeholder representation: SMEs aims at ensuring the representation of SMEs stakeholders in the EU Ecolabel.
Lot 2 - Stakeholder representation: consumers aims at ensuring the representation of consumer organisations in the EU Ecolabel.
Lot 3 - Stakeholder representation: environment aims at ensuring the representation of environmental organisations in the EU Ecolabel.
